verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers data/workspace export (message history) and MCP/API tooling, but nowhere mentions an audit log feature for admin/user actions (e.g., Enterprise Grid Audit Logs API) — the closest items (slack-docs-22/23/35/36) are about content export, not action auditing, and community evidence even highlights restrictions on exporting workspace data. Missing for 10: any documentation of an audit log API/dashboard tracking admin or user actions, retention/SIEM export details, or independent confirmation of such a feature.
